## A slide with notes

This is the content the audience sees on the slide.

::: {.notes}
These are speaker notes. They are rendered as a hidden `<aside class="notes">`
and do not appear on the slide itself. (Displaying them in a live speaker
view — the reveal.js notes plugin, the `S` key — is not wired up yet.)
:::
